# benchmark-cache-and-native-evidence

## User Persona
An operator needing source-qualified diagnosis without native execution authority.

## Scenario Coverage
Advanced integration route. Source-backed combined scenario, not a model test run.

## Expected Successful Behavior
- The answer distinguishes cfg/ignored/actual GPU execution and does not treat a CPU reference as CPU-only GPU proof.
- The answer preserves the current0.31.2 runner versus later0.32.2 report and distinct harness identity.
- The answer distinguishes in-process throughput from HTTP/cache/service quality evidence.
- The answer preserves reported long-context prefill disadvantages rather than a universal faster claim.

## Failure Signals
Forcing unsupported layout/API/state, missing lookahead or a static/ignored result upgraded to native/E2E proof.
